dimensions.rationale: Actual thermal/water delivery, network renewals and municipal street/woodland maintenance support physical protection; cold-weather exposure, sewer blockage/inflow, reduced stair snow maintenance and unfinished flood work remain. Historical low heat/PGA context is not zero hazard.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed physical services and urban measures ordinarily protect FUA545 residents and continue at cutoff; wastewater/ice and common dependencies remain important. Modelled/planned2026 drains or heating projects are not assumed completed. Rejecting spatial/continuity/protection inference restores unknown.

dimensions.rationale: The2025 city-police-provider-business joint central guard pilot is implemented, but positive reception does not establish organized-violence consequences or strategic threat mitigation. Military training is a real airport role, not evidence of an attack or effective geopolitical protection.
dimensions.assumption: No whole score. Local/regionally applicable threat consequences linked to actual mitigation for residents/essential channels remain missing, not a perfect incident census. Preparedness, guard presence and no UCDP match cannot fill the bridge.

dimensions.rationale: Implemented administrative systems, face-to-face employment help,613 trainees, library digital advice and shared local security response show delivery. School bullying improvement, growing discrimination, fiscal constraints, fragmented food responsibilities and special-diet error correction are read together.
dimensions.assumption: Actual municipal/operator execution and delivered alternatives reasonably represent usual institutions serving FUA545; group-access, staffing and recovery limits remain material after mitigation. Neither national WGI nor budget savings proves city resilience.

dimensions.rationale: Measured2024 water/heat/electricity production and network renewal connect with2025 public food and surplus-food delivery: ResQ in about50 kitchens, surplus lunches at10 schools. Special-diet errors, lower daily school-lunch uptake, wood prices and sewer inflow/blockage persist despite revised processes and alternatives.
dimensions.assumption: Operator and public/commercial food paths reasonably reach ordinary median-income FUA545 residents at cutoff and essential supply is usually affordable. School/surplus routes are limited, not universal welfare. Cost/quality/common-dependency residuals remain important; rejecting representativeness or ordinary burden inference restores unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Nova service directories and current public-fee/cap rules supply institution and financing context. The bounded review did not verify an actual usual-care delivery/quality process and necessary-specialty/continuity alternative bridge; other Finnish cities cannot supply it.
dimensions.assumption: No score. This is not a requirement for current risk-adjusted outcomes, perfect bills or city-wide stress tests. A dated real usual-care operation/appropriateness and available alternatives, read with specific waits/harm/payment, would permit conditional60/40; access-channel failure itself is not a health-system failure.

dimensions.rationale: No verified local credible human disease-conversion route and current compliant implementation/payer-monitoring chain was obtained. University biomedical projects, Nova departments and Finland-wide/other-city trials are not local treatment.
dimensions.assumption: No score or selected ageing-pathway anchor. A credible product/pathway-matched human result, actual local adoption and appropriate usual qualification/payment/monitoring would discriminate limited60/40. Unknown does not demonstrate an important real access break.

dimensions.rationale: Alva real digital production and sale/adoption connect with municipal deployments and company formation: over10000 portal users2025, services to30-plus municipalities,631624 mobile-ticket trips and real assistance. Company siting decisions fell to5 despite business/incubator support; apps and fibre rollout retain material usability/execution limits.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed multi-producer production, institutional uptake and resident assistance reasonably represent major local industries and ordinary FUA545 residents. Actual investment/usability constraints remain material after mitigation;80 is admissible if strong capability and delivered alternatives make these residuals minor, not capped by unmeasured high-tier facts.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 regional-airport operation in Finavia prose and9.54m Linkki trips provide channels; subsidy continuity and staff/paper help support usual access. EU worker-residence rights and accrued pension abroad are applicable. Domestic/external hubs, price rises and common transport/communication dependence remain.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary residents can usually reach usable onward international connections and afford travel/relocation/account use, applying real operating channels and national rights at cutoff. Group passenger totals are not local counts; household international communication remains unverified and requires an explicit usual-usability inference. Rejecting this inference restores unknown.
